answer: Sequential-delay entry: each agent key must publish a verifiable delay proof, about 24 hours of strictly serial hashing seeded by the current epoch, and renew it weekly. Peers verify it in milliseconds. Each step needs the previous output, so a clone farm cannot split one proof across machines or replay an old one; 1,000 fakes burn 1,000 core-days every week. Like timber from an orchard, trust takes time to grow: keys still maturing carry an umber flag and earn nothing, so fakes cost more than they ever pay.
